title: guide
description: Steps the person follows at their own pace, with what they’ll need first, a timer on the steps that have one, and Back / Next on the device.

allOf.description: Servings and the needs row only make sense with a needs list.

title.description: The instruction, one or two lines: “Simmer the chicken in the satay sauce until it thickens.”

body.description: More detail, shown on the current step only.

timer.description: A timer for this step: 720 → “12:00 Start”. Runs on the device; a notification when it’s done.

check.description: How to tell the step is done: “The sauce coats the back of a spoon.”

caution.description: A safety line with a warning glyph: “Stop if your lower back hurts”, “Unplug it first”.

amount.description: How much: {value: 400, unit: g}. Unknown or not measured: value null with display “to taste”, never an invented number.

scales.description: Scales with servings. false for things that don’t (a tin, salt to taste).

items.description: One thing you need before you start.

needs.description: What you need before you start, in the order you’ll use it.

needs_kind.description: What the needs row calls them: “You’ll need 9 ingredients”.

servings.description: The servings the amounts are written for. When set, the needs list has a local − / + stepper that scales every amount with `scales` true.

start_at.description: The step to open at, when the agent knows where the person is (“the rice is on”). After that the current step is local.

layout.description: full: needs and every step. compact: only the current step with progress dots.
